comment: Server side of the wasm-client-vs-native-server harness. Same --listen-driven connection as the native<->native WebRTC config, but with a much longer end_time: that config's peer is a second native process (fast cold start), while this one's peer is a headless-Chromium wasm client -- cold Emscripten+WebGL boot, SwiftShader warm-up and the WebRTC handshake all have to fit inside this window before the server self-closes, or the run fails on a timeout instead of a real assertion. Sized to match the CI job's BOOT_TIMEOUT_MS+CONNECT_TIMEOUT_MS margin (60s+90s=150s); keep them in sync.
